lineage_rules: Primary authority identifiers and adopted-plan records are kept separate from GLA service inventory.
FeatureServer root metadata is not child-layer metadata or exact candidate membership.
GPKG catalogue metadata is not binary content, file integrity or point-layer intersection.
Emerging, draft, proposed, review and future timetable states are never promoted as adopted/current positives.
Missing response bodies or inaccessible URLs are not negative evidence.
Exact positive binding requires raw query/GPKG geometry plus primary spatial and temporal cross-check.
No permission, capacity, finance, ownership, construction or delivery outcome is inferred from policy labels.
